rows.title: `@get` — a decorator of the mobile platform
rows.summary: An http GET on a method of a `repository` (without a body).
body: An **http GET** on a method of a `repository` (without a body).
| `path` | appended to the `@repository` path; `:name` takes a parameter |
| `cache = true`, `cacheKey`, `ttl` | keeps each response until `ttl` (5 min by default) |
| `retry` | attempts on temporary failures (2 by default for GET) |
| `local = true` | saves the rows it answers (a model with `@primary`, or a list) in the local database and adds `<method>AsLocal()`; `@repository(saveLocal = true)` does it for every GET |
The parameters that are not in the path go to the query.

rows.title: `@primary` — a decorator of the mobile platform
rows.summary: On a field of a model: its key in the local database.
body: On a field of a model: its **key** in the local database. The model gets a table (`Character.table`,
a `LocalTable`), and a `repository` with `saveLocal = true` keeps there what its GET methods answer.
The JSON name of the field (`@key`) is the column.
One `@primary` per model; the same word as a backend entity. `@primary(generated = true)`: the table gives the key

rows.title: `@repository` — a decorator of the mobile platform
rows.summary: On a `repository`: the base `path` of its requests, the `connection` they use and whether its GET methods save what they answer in the local database (`saveLocal`).
body: On a `repository`: the base `path` of its requests, the `connection` they use and whether its GET
methods save what they answer in the local database (`saveLocal`).
`path` is appended to the connection's `baseUrl`; `connection` is a `connectionName` of the
`appConfig` or a `config` (`""` = the default one). `saveLocal = true`: every `@get` that answers a model
with `@primary` (or a list of them) saves its rows on the device and gets `<method>AsLocal()`, which
answers the same without a request.

rows.title: `@screen` — a decorator of the mobile platform
rows.summary: Makes a `stateless` or `stateful` a screen: its route, the managers it creates and who may open it.
body: Makes a `stateless` or `stateful` a **screen**: its route, the managers it creates and who may open
it. One decorator with everything (an unknown argument is `N0217`).
| `route = "/users/:id"` | a route of `appRouter`; `:id` is a parameter of the screen, the others go in the query |
| `providers = [Manager]` | creates those managers for the screen; `Manager.x()` inside uses them |
| `loggedIn = { forward: Login }` | without a session, the router goes to `forward` |
| `acl = { roles, permissions, guards, forward }` | the session must pass the rule, or the router goes to `forward` |
| `shell = { widget: MainShell, tab: 0 }` | the screen is a tab of `widget` (each tab keeps its stack) |
| `notFound = true` | the screen for an address no route has |
A route inside another's address (`/characters/:id` in `/characters`) stacks on it: back returns there.
Navigate with the screen, not the address: `context.goTo(UserScreen(id = 7))`,

rows.title: `@splash` — a decorator of the mobile platform
rows.summary: The native launch screen of the screen that is the splash: the background color and image the device shows while the app starts.
body: The **native launch screen** of the screen that is the splash: the background color and image the
device shows while the app starts.
tap icon ─► native splash (@splash) ─► first frame: SplashScreen ─► onLoad + minDuration ─► next
└─────────── same color and image: no visible jump ──────────┘
- `color` is required; `image` is a 4x image of `assets/`.
- One per project; its route becomes the initial one.

rows.title: `@state` — a decorator of the mobile platform
rows.summary: On a method of a `statemanager`: the method's value is emitted as that state.
body: On a method of a `statemanager`: the method's value is **emitted as that state**. A `Result` that
fails emits the `error` state. Without a body, it emits the state with its parameters.
The caller receives nothing (`void`): the screen sees the new state.

rows.title: `aggregate` — a kind of the mobile platform
rows.summary: A business aggregate: rules of the domain that several use cases share (a cart with its prices, a set of permissions).
body: A **business aggregate**: rules of the domain that several use cases share (a cart with its
prices, a set of permissions). Its dependencies are injected.
Its file: `components/{component}/domain/aggregates/{file}.nuc` (`{component}`: the component's folder, `{file}`: the name in snake_case).

rows.title: `appConfig` — a kind of the mobile platform
rows.summary: The configuration of the whole app (in `config/`): its connections and its global services.
body: The **configuration of the whole app** (in `config/`): its connections and its global services.
└──────► globals ─────► Events, SessionManager, Acl, NetworkManager, Translations
- Each connection has a `connectionName` (`""` is the default one); names do not repeat.
- A component adds its own with `config`.
- `local: LocalDatabase = LocalDatabase(encrypted = true)` says how the local database (the tables of the models
with `@primary`) is kept: encrypted (the default: AES-256, key in the device's secure storage) or plain.
Its file: `config/project_config.nuc` (`{component}`: the component's folder, `{file}`: the name in snake_case).

rows.title: `appcomponent` — a kind of the mobile platform
rows.summary: The facade of a component: aliases to the `exec` of its use cases.
body: The **facade of a component**: aliases to the `exec` of its use cases. It is the only part of the
component that screens and other components see.
- `getPage() = GetPageUseCase.exec` is the same function as `exec`: same parameters, same
Its file: `components/{component}/{component}_component.nuc` (`{component}`: the component's folder, `{file}`: the name in snake_case).

rows.title: `chat` — a kind of the mobile platform
rows.summary: A conversation with a model (plugin `genkit`): its `prompt`, its `model` (connection name) and the tools of its constructor parameters.
body: A **conversation** with a model (plugin `genkit`): its `prompt`, its `model` (connection name) and the tools of its constructor parameters. `~chat.send(text)` answers and keeps the history; `chat.stream(text)` gives the answer piece by piece; `ChatController(chat)` is the state of a chat screen (messages, sending, error). Each `inject<Assistant>()` is a new conversation.
prompt: string = "You keep notes with your tools."
Its file: `components/{component}/ai/{file}.nuc` (`{component}`: the component's folder, `{file}`: the name in snake_case).

rows.title: `component` — a kind of the mobile platform
rows.summary: A global component (in `shared/components/`): a cross-cutting use case any declaration can use.
body: A **global component** (in `shared/components/`): a cross-cutting use case any declaration can use.
A method with `@on(Event)` runs with every event of that type, wherever the user is.
Its file: `shared/components/{file}.nuc` (`{component}`: the component's folder, `{file}`: the name in snake_case).

rows.title: `config` — a kind of the mobile platform
rows.summary: The configuration of one component (in `components/<c>/config/`): connections and services only that component uses, and the color of its logs.
body: The **configuration of one component** (in `components/<c>/config/`): connections and services only
that component uses, and the color of its logs.
- Same fields as `appConfig` (`connections`, `globals`, `local`) plus `logColor`; its `local` applies to the
tables of the component's own models.
- Connection names are unique in the whole project.
Its file: `components/{component}/config/{component}_config.nuc` (`{component}`: the component's folder, `{file}`: the name in snake_case).

rows.title: `converter` — a kind of the mobile platform
rows.summary: A JSON converter for a model field whose type the JSON does not bring as is (a date, a color).
body: A **JSON converter** for a model field whose type the JSON does not bring as is (a date, a color).
A field uses it by writing `@Name` above it.
- Only `fromJson(json: J) T` and `toJson(value: T) J`, both required (`N0209`); the types of
- It lives anywhere (usually `shared/converters/`) and every component can use it.
- Optional `sample() T`: the value generated tests use for a type they cannot invent (`Uri`, a color).
Its file: `shared/converters/{file}.nuc` (`{component}`: the component's folder, `{file}`: the name in snake_case).

rows.title: `event` — a kind of the mobile platform
rows.summary: A global event: a typed message.
body: A **global event**: a typed message. Whoever publishes it does not know who listens.
| `Events.publish(ForceLogout())` | publishes it (also from a background isolate or a workmanager task) |
| `EventBuilder<ForceLogout>(builder = (context, e) => ...)` | redraws with the last event |
| `EventListener<ForceLogout>(onEvent = ..., child = ...)` | runs code with each event |
Delivery is **on demand**: only the visible screen receives events; a hidden one gets the last
event of each type when it shows again. Global components (`component`) always receive them.
An event has `fromJson`/`toJson`: from a background task it travels as JSON, so its
fields are JSON types (basic, `DateTime`, enums, models, lists).
├──► hidden screens … (last event kept, delivered on return)
Its file: `shared/events/{file}.nuc` (`{component}`: the component's folder, `{file}`: the name in snake_case).

rows.title: `flow` — a kind of the mobile platform
rows.summary: A Genkit flow (plugin `genkit`): one AI operation with a typed input and output (`run(input: I) O`), registered in Genkit (traces, Developer UI).
body: A **Genkit flow** (plugin `genkit`): one AI operation with a typed input and output (`run(input: I) O`), registered in Genkit (traces, Developer UI). Call it like a function: `~summarize(text)`. `~generateObject<Summary>(prompt)` makes the model answer a model of the app (structured output).
Its file: `components/{component}/ai/{file}.nuc` (`{component}`: the component's folder, `{file}`: the name in snake_case).

rows.title: `form` — a kind of the mobile platform
rows.summary: A form model: the fields of a form and their rules.
body: A **form model**: the fields of a form and their rules. No header
- Every rule takes `message = ...`: a dictionary key or the text.
- The form widgets (`FormTextField("user")`) are bound to a field **by its name**.
- Format rules belong to the presentation; business rules stay in the domain (`@validate`).
Its file: `components/{component}/presentation/{screen}/forms/{file}.nuc` (`{component}`: the component's folder, `{file}`: the name in snake_case).

rows.title: `formmanager` — a kind of the mobile platform
rows.summary: The state of a form: values, errors and remote validations (`FormManager<F>`).
body: The **state of a form**: values, errors and remote validations (`FormManager<F>`).
`@form(F)` binds it to its form model.
keystroke ─► rules of LoginForm ─ ok ─► 400 ms later ─► @validate("user") ─► error or null
└─ fail ─► error shown when the user leaves the field
- A `@validate("field")` method receives the value and returns the error message or `null`.
- The screen lists it in `providers`; `DragonflyForm(manager = LoginFormManager, onSubmit = ...)`
Its file: `components/{component}/presentation/{screen}/managers/{file}.nuc` (`{component}`: the component's folder, `{file}`: the name in snake_case).

rows.title: `guard` — a kind of the mobile platform
rows.summary: A custom access check.
body: A **custom access check**. A single method `canActivate()` (`N0215`); its
Used in a screen, `@screen(acl = { guards: [PremiumGuard], forward: DeniedScreen })`, and in a use
With `~` in its body it waits (`Future<bool>`): the router, `AclBuilder`, an async use case and
`~Acl.check(guards = [...])` wait for it; the sync `Acl.can` throws.
Its file: `shared/guards/{file}.nuc` (`{component}`: the component's folder, `{file}`: the name in snake_case).

rows.title: `integration` — a kind of the mobile platform
rows.summary: Integration tests (in `integration_test/`): the real app on a device or emulator.
body: **Integration tests** (in `integration_test/`): the real app on a device or emulator.
Its file: `integration_test/{file}.nuc` (`{component}`: the component's folder, `{file}`: the name in snake_case).

rows.title: `knowledge` — a kind of the mobile platform
rows.summary: A knowledge base (plugin `genkit`): texts searched by meaning with the embedder of a provider (`embedder = "..."`).
body: A **knowledge base** (plugin `genkit`): texts searched by meaning with the embedder of a provider (`embedder = "..."`). `documents()` gives the first texts; `~facts.add(texts)` adds more; `~facts.search(question, k = 4)` gives the closest; `~facts.context(question)` gives them as a block for a prompt (RAG).
["Notes are kept while the app is open."]
Its file: `components/{component}/ai/{file}.nuc` (`{component}`: the component's folder, `{file}`: the name in snake_case).

rows.title: `model` — a kind of the mobile platform
rows.summary: A domain model: only its fields.
body: A **domain model**: only its fields. Nuclear writes the immutable class, `fromJson`/`toJson`
(json_serializable) and `==`. No header word is needed in `domain/models/` or `shared/models/`. With a
`@primary` field it has a local table, named by `@entity("table")` (default: the name in snake_case).
Generates `@JsonSerializable class Character` with a `const` constructor, `fromJson`, `toJson`,
- Generic models: `Page<T>` + `results: T[]`; each use says which: `Page<Character>`.
- The error type of a dragonfly `Result` (repositories, guards) has a `message: string` field.
- A model is visible from every component (`N0302` does not apply).
Its file: `components/{component}/domain/models/{file}.nuc` (`{component}`: the component's folder, `{file}`: the name in snake_case).

rows.title: `remote` — a kind of the mobile platform
rows.summary: Flows of a Genkit server (plugin `genkit`), called like a repository calls an API: `@remote("https://server")` on the kind, `@flow("path")` on a method that answers once, `@stream("path")` on one that streams its chunks.
body: **Flows of a Genkit server** (plugin `genkit`), called like a repository calls an API: `@remote("https://server")` on the kind, `@flow("path")` on a method that answers once, `@stream("path")` on one that streams its chunks. The input is the first parameter.
Its file: `components/{component}/data/{file}.nuc` (`{component}`: the component's folder, `{file}`: the name in snake_case).

rows.title: `repository` — a kind of the mobile platform
rows.summary: The http calls of a component (in `data/`).
body: The **http calls** of a component (in `data/`). Each method **without a body** and with a verb
decorator is one request; its return type says how the response is decoded.
| named in the path (`:id`) | the path |
| any other, with `@post`/`@put`/`@patch` | the body (one = the body as is; several = an object) |
- With `Result<E, T>` a failure is `Err(E(message = ...))`; without it, a `HttpError` is thrown.
- Methods are always async: call them with `~`.
- `@get`, `@put`, `@delete` retry 2 times on temporary failures; `@post`/`@patch` only with
- Only a `usecase` or an `aggregate` may use it (`N0301`).
With `@repository(saveLocal = true)` (or `@get(local = true)` on one method), a GET that answers a model with a
`@primary` field (or a list of them) also saves its rows in the **local database** of the app (encrypted, on the
device) and gets a twin `<method>AsLocal()` with the same signature that answers what that call last answered,
without a request. `local<Character>()` is the model's table: `find`, `findAll`, `save`, `remove`, and queries
backend repository (a plain `null` in `where` is "is null": `isNull` is the test matcher in this platform).
Its file: `components/{component}/data/{file}.nuc` (`{component}`: the component's folder, `{file}`: the name in snake_case).

rows.title: `service` — a kind of the mobile platform
rows.summary: Helpers of the use cases: mappings, transformations, calculations without state.
body: **Helpers of the use cases**: mappings, transformations, calculations without state. Its
Only a `usecase` or an `aggregate` may use it (`N0301`).
Its file: `components/{component}/domain/services/{file}.nuc` (`{component}`: the component's folder, `{file}`: the name in snake_case).

rows.title: `stateful` — a kind of the mobile platform
rows.summary: A widget with its own state: fields that change and redraw it with `setState`.
body: A **widget with its own state**: fields that change and redraw it with `setState`.
count = start               // start is read as widget.start
│ header parameters    │ ───────► │ fields of the block (count)  │
│ start: int           │  widget. │ methods: initState, build... │
- The header parameters are the inputs of the screen or widget; the fields and methods of the block are
its state, and a parameter is read as `widget.<name>`.
- `setState()` + block changes the state and draws it again.
- `State` members (`setState`, `context`, `widget`, `mounted`) exist without declaring them, and
- `build` is required (`N0209`). With `@screen` it is a screen, as in `stateless`.
Its file: `components/{component}/presentation/{screen}/{file}.nuc` (`{component}`: the component's folder, `{file}`: the name in snake_case).

rows.title: `stateless` — a kind of the mobile platform
rows.summary: A widget without its own state: everything it shows comes from its parameters.
body: A **widget without its own state**: everything it shows comes from its parameters. With `@screen`
it is also a screen (a route of the app).

rows.title: The mobile platform of Dragonfly
rows.summary: The mobile platform: apps for Android, iOS, desktop and web through one UI toolkit. 25 kinds, 42 decorators, 6 plugins; built by the dialects flutter (default: flutter).
body: A project of the platform is written once in Nuclear and builds with any of its dialects (`flutter`; `flutter` when none is named). Create one: `dragonfly new <name> -p mobile`.
- `stateless`: A widget without its own state: everything it shows comes from its parameters.
- `stateful`: A widget with its own state: fields that change and redraw it with `setState`.
- `appConfig`: The configuration of the whole app (in `config/`): its connections and its global services.
- `config`: The configuration of one component (in `components/<c>/config/`): connections and services only that component uses, and the color of its logs.
- `repository`: The http calls of a component (in `data/`).
- `usecase`: One business operation: a single method `exec` that returns a `Result`.
- `appcomponent`: The facade of a component: aliases to the `exec` of its use cases.
- `service`: Helpers of the use cases: mappings, transformations, calculations without state.
- `aggregate`: A business aggregate: rules of the domain that several use cases share (a cart with its prices, a set of permissions).
- `model`: A domain model: only its fields.
- `converter`: A JSON converter for a model field whose type the JSON does not bring as is (a date, a color).
- `form`: A form model: the fields of a form and their rules.
- `formmanager`: The state of a form: values, errors and remote validations (`FormManager<F>`).
- `component`: A global component (in `shared/components/`): a cross-cutting use case any declaration can use.
- `event`: A global event: a typed message.
- `tests`: A group of tests (in `test/`, no header word needed): unit, state and widget tests, with mocks from mocktail.
- `integration`: Integration tests (in `integration_test/`): the real app on a device or emulator.
- `tools`: Genkit tools (plugin `genkit`): each method with a doc comment is a tool the model can call; the doc comment is the description it reads and the parameters…
- `flow`: A Genkit flow (plugin `genkit`): one AI operation with a typed input and output (`run(input: I) O`), registered in Genkit (traces, Developer UI).
- `chat`: A conversation with a model (plugin `genkit`): its `prompt`, its `model` (connection name) and the tools of its constructor parameters.
- `remote`: Flows of a Genkit server (plugin `genkit`), called like a repository calls an API: `@remote("https://server")` on the kind, `@flow("path")` on a method that…
- `knowledge`: A knowledge base (plugin `genkit`): texts searched by meaning with the embedder of a provider (`embedder = "..."`).
